career_ladder.note: Officers recruited through the Goa Public Service Commission for the Goa Civil Service (Junior Scale) begin their career as Junior Scale Officers (Mamlatdar / Joint Mamlatdar / Block Development Officer / Under Secretary) and progress through the state civil service hierarchy before being considered for induction into the Indian Administrative Service (IAS) under the AGMUT cadre state promotion quota.

exam_scheme.note: Recruitment to the Junior Scale Officer of Goa Civil Service is conducted by the Goa Public Service Commission (GPSC) through a multi-tier selection process consisting of a Pre-Screening Computer Based Recruitment Test (CBRT), a Competitive Written Examination (250 marks), and an Oral Interview / Personality Test (40 marks). Final selection merit is determined strictly on the aggregate of the Written Examination and Interview (total 290 marks).

financial_package.note: Junior Scale Officers in the Goa Civil Service are compensated under the 7th Central Pay Commission Pay Matrix as adopted by the Government of Goa under Central Civil Services (Revised Pay) Rules, 2016 at Pay Matrix Level 10 (entry basic pay ₹56,100). Allowances include central-parity Dearness Allowance, House Rent Allowance (10% to 20%), Transport Allowance, and state executive perks.
financial_package.pay_source_label: Government of Goa Notification on CCS (Revised Pay) Rules 2016 & GPSC Advertisement No. 09/2025
financial_package.estimate_note: Gross calculated from Level 10 entry basic ₹56,100 + 58% DA (₹32,538) + HRA (10% to 20% depending on municipal classification such as Panaji/Margao or rural talukas) + Transport Allowance (₹3,600 + DA = ₹5,688). In-hand estimate accounts for statutory deductions including 10% NPS (Basic + DA = ₹8,864), Goa Professional Tax, and Group Insurance.
official_perks: Designated government executive accommodation / Type-V residential quarters in Panaji or district headquarters
Official staff car / vehicle with driver entitlement for administrative and field inspections
Statutory executive magisterial powers under Code of Criminal Procedure (CrPC/BNSS)
Comprehensive medical coverage for officer and dependent family members under Goa State Employees Health Scheme
Mobile phone and high-speed broadband internet reimbursement
Eligibility for career induction into the Indian Administrative Service (IAS) under AGMUT cadre promotion quota
